title: Use a first reply that collects the right details

content_json.title: Use a first reply that collects the right details
content_json.what_it_means: The first reply should make ordering easy without a long conversation.
what_to_do: Ask for product type, name/photo/design, date needed, and delivery area.
Keep the reply friendly and short.
Save it as a WhatsApp quick reply.
content_json.example: Hi, thanks for messaging {{businessName}}. Please send the product idea, name/photo/design, date needed, and area in {{location}}. I will reply with price and preview steps.
content_json.why_this_helps: You get useful details early, and customers feel guided.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if more customers send complete order details in the first message.

content_json.title: Give price without sounding unsure
content_json.what_it_means: Customers should know what affects the price.
what_to_do: Share a starting price or price range.
Mention what can change the price.
Confirm final price after preview details.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can say: Prices start from {{priceRange}}. Final price depends on product size, design detail, and delivery area.
content_json.why_this_helps: Price clarity brings serious buyers and reduces back-and-forth.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if more people continue the chat after receiving price.

title: Ask for preview confirmation in one clean message

content_json.title: Ask for preview confirmation in one clean message
content_json.what_it_means: The customer must confirm small details before the order starts.
what_to_do: Ask them to check spelling, photo, colour, size, and date.
Start only after they reply confirmed.
content_json.example: {{businessName}} can send: Please check the preview carefully. Confirm name spelling, photo, colour, size, and delivery date in {{location}}. I will start making it after you reply confirmed.
content_json.why_this_helps: It protects both the customer and the shop from avoidable mistakes.
content_json.how_to_check: Check if confirmed previews reduce correction requests later.
